title: Copilot Studio: share agents with other makers on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: Hold: the briefing treats Managed Environments sharing controls as unconfirmed for the Microsoft Copilot harness, although the cited harness FAQ explicitly identifies them as its sharing controls. It also narrows Microsoft's restriction on granting Editor permissions to security groups to the classic experience without supporting that exception. The roadmap facts and the documented control path and PowerShell call check out.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and PowerShell paragraph

claims.where: controls[0].scope and note; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The sharing rules are an environment-level Managed Environments control.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls: first paragraph; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether Managed Environments sharing rules govern Microsoft Copilot harness sharing remains unconfirmed and only likely.
claims.quote:
Admins govern it with four kinds of control: who can build agents, how much an agent can spend, what data and connectors it can reach, and who it can be shared with.

- Who agents are shared with: Managed environment sharing controls and environment security groups
claims.fix: Replace the unconfirmed-applicability wording in the control note and Governance controls with: 'The Microsoft Copilot harness FAQ identifies Managed environment sharing controls and environment security groups as controls over who agents are shared with.' Remove the Open questions bullet asking whether those controls apply. A recommendation to test enforcement can remain, but not a claim that Microsoft has not confirmed applicability.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and api; Governance controls table and final paragraph
claims.claim: No tenant-wide switch specifically turning maker-to-maker agent sharing off was found at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Microsoft Copilot harness sharing tenant-wide disable sharing PowerShell Dataverse API; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-platform tenant disable agent sharing. Read harness FAQ, Control how agents are shared, Limit sharing; no such tenant-wide UI or API found.

claims.claim: The harness sharing page does not specify which instructions or knowledge configuration details viewers can see.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio viewers instructions knowledge share. Read authoring-share-agent in full; it says view details and test, without enumerating visible instructions or knowledge configuration.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Only share with individuals (no security groups) prevents sharing with security groups.
claims.quote: Only share with individuals (no security groups) | If this setting is selected, owners and editors can only share with individuals as viewers. They can't share with a security group.

claims.claim: Learn warns that user-specific connections can make an agent work for its maker but fail for other users.
claims.quote: connections are tied to the identity of each individual agent user. This means an agent might work for you but not for other users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Other users can perform operations with a maker's permissions when the agent uses that maker's credential connection.
claims.quote: When an agent uses such a connection, other users of the agent can perform operations by using the permissions associated with the maker's credentials.

claims.claim: Tools configured to use end-user credentials use each user's own connection at runtime.
claims.quote: Connections configured to use end-user credentials aren't subject to this connection-sharing restriction because each user authenticates by using their own connection at runtime.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents that Editor permissions can be given to individual users but not security groups.
claims.quote:
**Editor** permissions can only be given to individual users.

You can't grant **Editor** permissions to security groups.

claims.claim: The restriction on granting Editor permissions to security groups is documented only for classic agents, leaving harness Editor access unstated.
claims.quote: When you set sharing controls in the Power Platform admin center, you can enforce how makers share **Editor** or **Viewer** assignments with other individuals for their agents in Copilot Studio.
claims.fix: Replace that bullet with: 'Learn states that Editor permissions can only be given to individual users, not security groups.' Remove the unsupported classic-only qualification and the sentence saying the harness limit is not stated. The harness sharing page links to this control documentation for assigning editing rights.

claims.claim: No approval step for an Editor's changes is documented in the feature sharing material checked.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot harness sharing approval; site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio sharing approval Editor. Read sharing page, sharing-controls page and FAQ; no mandatory approval step for Editor changes found.

claims.claim: The script retrieves an environment using Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId>.
claims.quote: $environment = Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId>

claims.claim: The script assigns the environment's Internal.properties.governanceConfiguration to $governanceConfiguration.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration = $environment.Internal.properties.governanceConfiguration

claims.claim: Adding bot-authoringSharingDisabled with value True using the printed Add-Member call disables sharing with individuals as Editors.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-authoringSharingDisabled' -Value True -Force

claims.claim: The page documents bot-limitSharingMode for restricting agent sharing with security groups.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-limitSharingMode' -Value "ExcludeSharingToSecurityGroups" -Force

claims.claim: The page documents bot-maxLimitUserSharing for limiting the number of agent viewers.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-maxLimitUserSharing' -Value "20" -Force
